title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 9
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q081_alarming
elements.title: Inspectors described the sudden rise in faults as ___ and warned that immediate review was needed.

elements.name: q082_break_the_chain
elements.title: By stopping a bad habit before passing it on to the next generation, she hoped to ___.

elements.name: q083_under_way
elements.title: “An investigation is under way.” Which statement is true?
choices: The investigation may be proposed later.
The investigation has begun and is ongoing.
elements.correctAnswer: The investigation has begun and is ongoing.

elements.name: q084_chronology
elements.title: To follow the ___ of events, read the entries in the order they happened.

elements.name: q085_ripple
elements.title: The effect of the closure began to ___ through neighbouring towns as more shops lost customers.

elements.name: q086_drag_on
elements.title: The meeting was meant to last twenty minutes, but it continued to ___ well past lunchtime.

elements.name: q087_feel_the_squeeze
elements.title: As rent and bills rose, small businesses began to feel ___.

elements.name: q088_lock_eyes
elements.title: Their conversation stopped when they locked ___. They stood silently looking directly at each other.

elements.name: q089_give_urgency
elements.title: The approaching deadline gave urgency to the decision. What does this mean?
choices: It guaranteed that everyone would agree.
It removed the need to decide.
It made the decision feel more pressing.
elements.correctAnswer: It made the decision feel more pressing.

elements.name: q090_in_the_wake_of
elements.title: Several shops closed ___ the flood, which had damaged the entire street.
